brain.label: Brain
brain.summary: brain views, illustrated neurons, books, science equipment and creative thinking motifs
brain.lead: Brain views, nerve cells and illustrations about learning and ideas.
brain.intro: Choose a brain illustration for a classroom display, a learning journal or a creative project. The collection includes colorful views, decorative symbols and shaded black-and-white drawings.
brain.note: These are stylized illustrations, including imaginary gears, flowers and other visual metaphors. The anatomy-inspired views are unlabeled artwork, rather than clinical diagrams or a labeled reference atlas.
